name: evil eye

attributes.attribute: could curse a person or gain an object through a gaze
feared in rural Ireland and Scotland
called Balor of the Evil Eye

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The evil eye is a harmful power carried in a gaze. A spiteful person could curse another with a single glance. Covetous people could take an object with one sharp look. Squinting, seen in the nearsighted, was sometimes read as a curse. These guards stayed used in rural Ireland through the 1800s. People relied on spoken charms and protective gestures. Scots kept full-bladdered cows from the barn and tied red thread. This folk fear links to Balor of the Evil Eye. See also EYE.

key_results: Define the evil eye as a curse through a look
